narration_script: Frank steps out into the open as the hunters close in.
Over here, over here, come out Frank!
He draws the armed thugs deeper into the corridors.
Get off of me, come on!
The trap springs shut as the chaos escalates.
hook: Frank draws the mob into a deadly game of cat and mouse.

narration_script: We are coming for you, Frank!
He fights through relentless waves of attackers inside the building.
Charli and her father get caught in the middle of the brutal crossfire.
Get out of my fucking shop, you motherfucker!
hook: Gunfire erupts as the building turns into a war zone.

narration_script: Frank steps in to rescue them from the murderous thugs.
He protects the innocent despite the chaos surrounding them.
We gotta get you to the hospital.
One batch, two batch, penny and dime.
Papa Bear is a baker, and so am I.
I love you, baby girl, till the end of time.
hook: Frank delivers brutal justice and finds his final resolve.
